shared_tail.surface: إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين

notes: The first branch ends at Zayd and the second repeats him; the text writes the rest once after the last ḥ, so it is the shared tail (rule 3)
«- وهذا حديثه -» is an editor's gloss: left out
Abu Ayyub speaks inside the narrated story; the chain as written ends at the two Companions and no link is added for him
